01 — ABOUT

Engineering reliable systems for real-world scale.

I'm a Java Full Stack Developer with 7 years of experience building enterprise applications across financial services, telecommunications, and healthcare.

My primary focus is backend engineering using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architecture. I have experience developing event-driven systems with Apache Kafka, optimizing relational databases, and deploying containerized applications on AWS and Azure.

I also work with Angular for frontend development and contribute to application modernization, CI/CD automation, security improvements, and production troubleshooting.

I enjoy solving complex backend problems, improving application performance, and building software that is maintainable, secure, and reliable.
